items.title: Urban Biodiversity Plans Systematically Exclude Marginalized Populations
items.one_liner: New findings show urban biodiversity plans systematically exclude marginalized groups from decisions.
items.why: Highlights environmental justice and equity gaps in urban greening and ecosystem service distribution.
items.action: Incorporate critical appraisal of stakeholder inclusion into the literature review on planning justice.

items.title: COP31: Brazil proposes public solutions to lead climate action in Global South
items.one_liner: Brazil proposes public solutions for climate leadership and action in the Global South at COP31.
items.why: Informs policy frameworks and public intervention strategies for climate resilience in the Global South.
items.action: Examine the specific public solution proposals for application to Global South urban contexts.

items.title: COP31: Leaders Put Resilient Cities on the Table. Will the Money Follow?
items.one_liner: Discussions at COP31 focus on urban resilience, raising questions about funding commitments.
items.why: Connects international climate policy debates directly to municipal finance and urban green infrastructure.
items.action: Track ongoing COP31 announcements regarding dedicated financial mechanisms for urban resilience.

items.title: Interconnected Water Risks Amplify Infectious Disease in Informal Settlements
items.one_liner: Research highlights how water risks increase infectious disease in informal urban settlements.
items.why: Directly links to urban ecosystem services, water management, and vulnerabilities in informal settlements.
items.action: Review the underlying study for methods connecting hydrological risks to social vulnerability.

items.title: Ho Chi Minh City Approves 2025–2050 Master Plan
items.one_liner: Ho Chi Minh City formally approved its comprehensive 2025–2050 master development plan.
items.why: Provides a real-world case of long-term urban planning and land-cover change management in the Global South.
items.action: Analyze how the master plan addresses green-blue infrastructure and peri-urban development.

note: Selected updates, not comprehensive coverage. Status is unverified unless supported by the quoted official excerpt.
